build_prioritized_double_q_learning: build a DQN agent using PrioritizedDoubleQLearning loss with importance sampling and Huber loss on TD error
build_quantile_regression_dqn: build a Quantile Regression DQN agent using QrDqn loss with configurable number of atoms for distributional RL
build_categorical_double_q_learning: build a Categorical DQN agent using PrioritizedCategoricalDoubleQLearning loss with distributional RL and importance sampling
build_standard_q_learning: build a standard DQN agent using QLearning loss with squared TD error matching the original DQN paper
build_munchausen_q_learning: build a Munchausen DQN agent using MunchausenQLearning loss with entropy regularization and soft Bellman operator
